admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
What does the monthly tidy-up do?

On the last day of each month, the tidy-up removes flagged entries and drafts older than ninety days from your journal. Entries that are neither flagged nor drafts are left alone. Removed items cannot be restored.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b:
Journal tidy-up

Once a month, on the last day, the tidy-up runs on your journal. It removes all flagged entries, whatever their age, and any drafts older than ninety days. Entries that are neither flagged nor drafts are left alone. Removed items cannot be restored.
